metadata.title: AI Incident Response

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for detecting, classifying, containing, and recovering from AI-specific incidents and harms.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: AI operations, agentic systems, decision-support platforms, and research AI environments.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern defining how AI-related incidents are identified, classified, contained, and resolved, including epistemic and behavioral harm.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Provides AI-specific threat context for incidents involving hallucination, misuse, model abuse, and autonomous or cascading agent failure.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Incidents where AI produces incorrect, fabricated, or misleading output that causes downstream harm.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Incidents arising from agentic AI acting beyond authorized scope or without effective human intervention.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.value: Cascading Agent Failure and Delegation Abuse
props.remarks: Incidents where errors or misuse propagate across agent-to-agent interactions.

metadata.remarks: AI Incident Response defines how the institution responds to AI-specific incidents, including hallucination harm, unsafe autonomy, misuse, and cascading agent failures. This pattern extends traditional incident response to address epistemic, behavioral, and socio-technical risks unique to AI systems.

components.title: AI Incident Classification
components.description: Identification and categorization of AI-specific incidents distinct from traditional security events.

implemented-requirements.remarks: AI-related incidents are categorized based on epistemic harm, misuse, autonomy failure, or cascading impact.

components.title: Containment and De-Scoping
components.description: Rapid limitation or suspension of AI capabilities to prevent further harm during an incident.

implemented-requirements.remarks: AI systems can be paused, de-scoped, or have capabilities revoked in response to detected incidents.

components.title: Re-Trust and Communication
components.description: Restoration of trust through remediation, validation, and transparent communication with stakeholders.

implemented-requirements.remarks: AI systems are revalidated and stakeholders informed before resuming normal operation after an incident.
